info.title: playnet gateway doors
info.description: Every door the browser may call, declared once in module/playnet/protocol.scm and emitted here, grouped by topic. The HTTP door (POST /api/{object}/{name}) carries the same doors CapTP does; a call is signed with an enrolled device key (RFC 9421) unless the door is anonymous. The same doors are MCP tools: POST /api/mcp speaks JSON-RPC (initialize, tools/list, tools/call), and browser/api/mcp-tools.json is the committed tool list. Doors a client cannot reach (root tier, operator) are listed under x-playnet-doors.
